This plot is not mine — I rent it — so I am careful not to put too much money into land that is not mine. I have some schooling, so I know fertilizer helps, but cash is tight and I am a woman without easy credit, so I will buy just one bag of NPK and stretch it across this plot. I will use my own seed from last harvest because improved seed costs too much and the agro-dealer is far. My children and I will do most of the work, but at weeding time I will pay two or three people for a few days because I cannot finish alone.
